problems.title: Missing involution in full-weight Lambda duality
problems.claim: Perfect untwisted Lambda-bilinear pairing with adjoint t->w0(t^-1).
problems.assumptions: Full GSp torus; common diagonal-invariant family and specialization convention; g1p5 regular weight kappa(4;-4), nu(-2;4), neat tame level.

problems.result: Declared untwisted pairing and adjoint cannot both be perfect at this allowed fiber.
problems.impact: Main structural duality statement false under displayed actions; no refutation of Hida existence/control or fixed-weight Serre duality.
problems.correction: Insert iota[t]=[w0(t^-1)] on second Lambda factor or state sesquilinearity. Character/specialization repair verified; all global transition compatibility and full corrected perfect-pairing proof not newly reconstructed.

independent_acceptance.hypothesis_check: Checked the full GSp torus, scalar-center character, diagonal-invariant definition and common -nu specialization. The preceding w-twist fixes the center and supplies no second-factor involution.
independent_acceptance.decisive_reasoning: The fixed-weight partner transforms nu to -w0*nu. At g=1,p=5,kappa=(4;-4), nu=(-2;4), the ordinary form E4(q)-125E4(q^5) is nonzero and U5-fixed by the all-coefficient divisor-sum identity. At the common Lambda fiber u=6I acts by 6^4 and its specified adjoint on the second factor by 6^-4. Their nonzero difference 1679615/1296 forces any asserted bilinear adjoint pairing to vanish over Q5, contradicting perfectness at that nonzero fiber.
independent_acceptance.repair_and_boundary: The involution iota([t])=[w0(t^-1)] restores the second specialization and character compatibility. This is the necessary local correction; every global transition compatibility for a new twisted perfect-pairing proof has not been reconstructed. Fixed-weight Serre duality and the rest of the framework are not refuted.

problems.title: Dyadic Levi quotient differs from Levi intersection
problems.check: epsilon multiplicative andoddrootaction preserveshalfclass. U_K=Z2; projectionallunits²,intersectiona=1mod4. Mod4exactgroup8elementscorrobprojection4vsintersection2.

independent_acceptance.decisive_reasoning: For the dyadic subgroup with u in (1/2)Z2 and 2u mod2=(a-1)/2 mod2, epsilon is multiplicative and the odd root action is trivial modulo Z2. Thus it is compact open and Galois-stable. Its Levi projection is all unit pairs, while its Levi intersection requires a=1 mod4; (-1,-1,1/2) witnesses nonsurjectivity of the intersection into the quotient.
independent_acceptance.repair_and_counterevidence: Use pr_M(K) or restrict to split compacts. Section 5.1 explicitly imposes the split condition even at two and has a cofinal such collection; the later family statement is not refuted.

problems.title: Stratum assertions exceed positive-depth and special-fiber domains

independent_acceptance.decisive_reasoning: At n=0 all graded groups are trivial and hence multiplicative, so the source's ordinary assertion includes the supersingular curve y^2=x^3+1 over F5 (six points, trace zero). Separately, g=2,n=1,j1=0,j2=2 satisfies the index ranges, but the complements of vertical divisors contain the nonempty generic fiber despite the invalid increment.
independent_acceptance.repair_and_counterevidence: Restrict the level assertion to n>=1 and the invalid-increment emptiness to the special fiber/formal setting. Positive levels are cofinal and the valid zero/one charts survive. These boundary errors remain local.
